periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique, angled approximately 45 degrees downward towards the mandibular region.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a width-to-height ratio approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering with the lowest point extending toward the ventral-lateral plane of the muzzle.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shape across the posterior margin of the interscapular region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Consistent thickness covering approximately 30% of the visible dorsal length from neck to mid-back.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation, distance between medial ear bases is roughly twice the width of a single ear pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex, smooth semicircular curvature at the superior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Dorsal and hindquarter pelage exhibits a distinct tan or brownish-yellow tint compared to the white cephalic region.
